en.t: I cannot grasp the point, and it troubles me."

units.source_text: 夕雾看了，脸上露出微笑，想道：

en.t: Yugiri read it, a smile appearing on his face, and thought:

units.source_text: “她如此东思西想而说出这种话来，

en.t: "For her to think this way and that and say such a thing,

units.source_text: 以为我是想念已故的老夫人，太不相称了。”

en.t: imagining that I am longing for the late old lady is completely off the mark."

units.source_text: 便立刻若无其事地复道：

en.t: He immediately replied as though nothing had happened:
